[B1] < cloudA | UserX : ('members' : Members , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'invite' cloudA | (UserY)
=> < cloudA | UserX : ('members' : (Members , UserY) , ...) , ... > .
[B1] < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : Device , ...) , UserY : ('device' : nils , ...) , ... >
=> < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : Device , ...) , UserY : ('device' : Device , ...) , ... > .

[B2] < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : Device , ...) , Device : ('key' : Key , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'requestKey' cloudA | (Device)
=> < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : Device , ...) , Device : ('key' : Key , ...) , ... > $ cloudA 'sendKey' UserX | (Device ; Key) .
[B2] < UserX | 'key' : nils , ... > $ cloudA 'sendKey' UserX | (Device ; Key)
=> < UserX | 'key' : Key , ... > .

[B3] < Device | 'key' : Key , 'on' : false , ... > $ UserX 'turnOn' Device | (Key)
=> < Device | 'key' : Key , 'on' : true , ... > if Key == Key .

[B4] < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : Device , ...) , ... > < Device | 'on' : false , ... > $ UserX 'cloudTurnOn' cloudA | (Device)
=> < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : Device , ...) , ... > < Device | 'on' : true , ... > .

[B5] < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : Device , ...) , 'members' : (UserY) , UserY : ('device' : UserDevice , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'removeMember' cloudA | (UserY)
=> < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : Device , ...) , 'members' : nils , UserY : ('device' : nils , ...) , ... > .

< cloudA | (userA : ('device' : deviceB , 'members' : nils) , userC : ('device' : nils , 'members' : nils) , 'members' : userA , deviceB : ('key' : nils)) > < userA | ('key' : nils) > < userC | ('key' : nils) > < deviceB | ('on' : false , 'key' : 'deviceKey') >

[B1] < UserX | 'key' : UserKey , ... > < UserY | 'key' : UserYKey , ... > < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : UserDevice , 'members' : UserMembers) , ... > => ev1(UserX, UserY) .
[B2] < UserX | 'key' : UserKey , ... > < Device | ... > => ev2(UserX, Device) .
[B3] < UserX | 'key' : Key , ... > < Device | ... > => ev3(UserX, Device, Key) .
[B4] < UserX | ... > < Device | ... > => ev4(UserX, Device) .
[B5] < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : Device , 'members' : (UserY)) , ... > => ev5(UserX, UserY) .

deviceOn =| < deviceB | 'on' : true , ... > .
attackerAuthorized =| < cloudA | userC : ('device' : deviceB , ...) , ... > .
